title: Node icon brief (node icon style pack v2)
description: What Tower Design Toolkit needs to draw a design-node icon in the family's style. The icon shows what the node actually does: one architectural object, at most one supporting cue, nothing the node cannot do. The same definition as $defs.iconBrief in the node package schema (tower-studio-node@1).

styleVersion.description: The style pack version the icon follows: "2" for this pack. (The platform still draws briefs saved under earlier versions in their own style.)

name.description: The node's name, as in its package (also the icon's accessible name). Never drawn into the icon.

function.description: What the node actually does, in plain words: what it reads, what it compares or shows. Not what it might do one day.

category.description: One of Tower Design Toolkit's 13 node categories.

phase.description: The workflow phase whose colour the accent takes. Left out, it follows the category.

object.description: The one main architectural object or spatial diagram (see NODE_ICON_STYLE.md section 9 for what each word draws).

cue.description: At most one small supporting cue, upper right; none if the object says it alone.

metaphor.description: The proposed picture, from the parts the platform draws with.

notes.description: What the icon must not imply, or what to show if the words above fall short.
